cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.21)
if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR)
    project(DoDevFilePreview VERSION 1.1.0 LANGUAGES CXX)
    include(GNUInstallDirs)
    enable_testing()
    option(DODEV_BUILD_TESTS "Build preview tests" ON)
    set(DODEV_SDK_INCLUDE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/include" CACHE PATH "Public SDK includes")
else()
    set(DODEV_SDK_INCLUDE "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/include")
endif()
add_library(dodev_preview_core STATIC src/FilePreview.cpp src/ExtraPreview.cpp src/ExternalPreview.cpp)
target_include_directories(dodev_preview_core PUBLIC include)
target_compile_features(dodev_preview_core PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
set_target_properties(dodev_preview_core PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
target_link_libraries(dodev_preview_core PUBLIC Threads::Threads)
find_package(SQLite3 QUIET)
if(SQLite3_FOUND)
    target_link_libraries(dodev_preview_core PUBLIC SQLite::SQLite3)
    target_compile_definitions(dodev_preview_core PUBLIC PREVIEW_SQLITE=1)
endif()
find_package(EXPAT QUIET)
if(EXPAT_FOUND)
    target_link_libraries(dodev_preview_core PUBLIC EXPAT::EXPAT)
    target_compile_definitions(dodev_preview_core PUBLIC PREVIEW_EXPAT=1)
endif()
add_library(dodev_file_preview_plugin MODULE src/PreviewPlugin.cpp)
target_include_directories(dodev_file_preview_plugin PRIVATE "${DODEV_SDK_INCLUDE}")
target_link_libraries(dodev_file_preview_plugin PRIVATE dodev_preview_core)
set(dir "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/plugins/file-preview")
set_target_properties(dodev_file_preview_plugin PROPERTIES LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${dir}" RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${dir}")
foreach(cfg IN LISTS CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
    string(TOUPPER "${cfg}" cfg)
    set_target_properties(dodev_file_preview_plugin PROPERTIES LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_${cfg} "${dir}" RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_${cfg} "${dir}")
endforeach()
if(WIN32)
    set_target_properties(dodev_file_preview_plugin PROPERTIES PREFIX "")
elseif(APPLE)
    set_target_properties(dodev_file_preview_plugin PROPERTIES SUFFIX ".dylib")
endif()
configure_file(plugin.json "${dir}/plugin.json" COPYONLY)
install(TARGETS dodev_file_preview_plugin LIBRARY DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}/plugins/file-preview" RUNTIME DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}/plugins/file-preview")
install(FILES plugin.json DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}/plugins/file-preview")
if(DODEV_BUILD_TESTS)
    add_executable(file_preview_tests tests/test_preview.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(file_preview_tests PRIVATE dodev_preview_core)
    find_program(PREVIEW_PDF_TEST_RENDERER pdftoppm)
    if(PREVIEW_PDF_TEST_RENDERER)
        target_compile_definitions(file_preview_tests PRIVATE PREVIEW_TEST_PDF=1)
    endif()
    if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR)
        add_test(NAME file_preview_formats COMMAND file_preview_tests)
    endif()
endif()
